en: Dependent on a cause that is inferior, a non-cause that is not inferior arises by way of the root condition (*hetupaccaya*) … [Three for the root condition] … [etc.

… three for non-disappearance (*avigata*). Dependent on a non-cause that is middling, a non-non-cause that is not middling arises by way of the root condition … [Three for the root condition] … [etc. … three for non-disappearance.
Dependent on a cause that is sublime, a non-cause that is not sublime arises by way of the root condition … [Three for the root condition] … [etc. … three for non-disappearance.
